description: privacy_mode = guest_present. A guest says personal information during the session. Expected: no durable memory write proceeds unless an explicit consent prompt is accepted; the write is gated pending consent. Tests that privacy_mode = guest_present gates personal-info writes per Part 7 and the test_guest_present_memory_gate contract. Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.privacy_mode: guest_present: durable memory writes about guest-sourced information are gated behind an explicit consent prompt. Writes about the primary user (pre-existing profile facts) are not affected.
fixture_conventions.consent_gate: When a personal-info utterance is detected while guest_present is active, the system must: (1) not write durably; (2) emit a consent_prompt event; (3) write only if and when consent is accepted. Write is permanently suppressed if consent is declined or not given.
fixture_conventions.guest_info_detection: The fixture scripts an utterance that contains personal information attributable to the guest (not the primary user). The system must classify it as guest-sourced before applying the gate.
fixture_conventions.primary_user_writes_unaffected: Writes to the primary user's profile that are not based on guest-sourced information proceed normally. The gate applies only to guest-originated content.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Privacy mode activation, guest utterance, gated write, and consent prompt sequence to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
